description: Procurement of Security Services for the National Savings Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- National Savings Bank obtains outsourced security services for its Head Office and island-wide branch network, and bids have been invited following the National Competitive Bidding procedure for the procurement of those services. 14 bids have been submitted for the same. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to award the contracts for the provision of security services to the National Savings Bank for a period of 02 years from 2026-10-01 as follows, based on the recommendations of the High Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.
